note: Values become binding only when the contract is FROZEN with proposer+auditor sign-off. Changing any value after an outcome is seen requires AMENDMENT-XXX and marks affected runs EXPLORATORY.

diagnostic_strata.STATIC_YAW_SWEEP: SAMPLES pose_ids not in timeline: R2 324 (18 XY x 18 yaw), R4 180 (10x18), R5 468 (26x18); 2268 rows over 7 cases; diagnostic only (LoS floor yaw dependence)

observer.first_path_rule: stronger-RX port, first tap >= 0.30 * that port's peak amplitude (identical to v_replay.ds1)
observer.tap_spacing_rule: dt = 1/(4*257*df), df read from freqs_hz.npy at runtime (current assets: df=1.95 MHz -> 0.4988526 ns); nominal 1/(4B) value forbidden
observer.log_fp_power: log10(max(P_plus(n0)+P_minus(n0), tiny)) as in PHYSICS_RS_STAGED/code/features.py; parity with HP_PACKETS checked in P0 (R-12)

metrics.highpass_cutoff_rule: spatial frequency above which s_LoS retains <=5% of its segment variance; computed per segment from LoS channel (ORACLE_ONLY, P2a diagnostic only, never in a deployable metric)
metrics.window_validity: valid iff n0-2>=0 and n0+6<N and all lag-shifted h_minus indices in [0,N); else INVALID_WINDOW flag retained, no clamp
metrics.xcorr: R(tau)=sum_{t in W} h_plus(t) conj(h_minus(t-tau)), h_minus from full CIR (no zero-fill); rho(tau)=R/sqrt(sum_W|h_plus|^2 * sum_{W-tau}|h_minus|^2); denominator<=tiny -> NaN + NULL_PORT

labels_ORACLE_ONLY.T3: eta_W = sum_W |h_Full - h_LoS|^2 / sum_W |h_LoS|^2 over both ports, tx=0
labels_ORACLE_ONLY.T4: per-path delta_k and |a wedge b_k| from realigned R2_aA traces; usable only if R-01 PASS
labels_ORACLE_ONLY.window_label_threshold: per fold: q0.80 of training-route causal-window mean |T1|

models.baseline_M0: G5 (PHYSICS_RS_STAGED/code/features.py: range_m, log_fp_power, abs_s_fp, early4, early8, early16, delay_rms_ns, peak_diff_ns, eta_fp_win80, s_diff4, s_diff8, s_diff16, tap_pol_var80, jones_diversity, freq_s_var, detector_s_span, detector_delay_span_ns) + |ds1|
models.primary_learner: logistic regression, standardized, C=1.0 fixed, no search
models.sensitivity_learner: RandomForest n_estimators=160, max_depth=6, min_samples_leaf=40, random_state=20261015 (prior study setting)

arms.E1b: M0 with jones_diversity replaced by q_W vs M0

statistics.split: leave-one-route-out (R2/R4/R5); cases of the held-out route all held out
statistics.bootstrap: 1.0 m travelled-distance blocks within route on timeline poses; block indices resampled jointly across cases sharing the route (aA, aB, m45); 2000 resamples, seed 20261029
statistics.primary_effect: delta AUC (candidate - baseline) per held-out route
statistics.go_rule_engineering: lower 95% CI of delta AUC > 0 in >= 2 of 3 held-out routes AND sign positive in 3 of 3
statistics.scientific_verdict_ceiling: RETROSPECTIVE data, 1 independent scene: verdict may not exceed SUPPORTED_RETROSPECTIVE; confirmatory claim requires new scene variants (BLOCKED)
statistics.turn_blocks: each contiguous turn-phase run = 1 block; no spatial-period analysis on turns
statistics.power_analysis: label-free: real block counts + synthetic labels under assumed delta AUC in {0.02, 0.05}; recorded before freeze

tolerances_fixed_before_run.s0_near_cancel_rule: |a + b*exp(j*psi)| < 0.3|a| stratified and excluded from slope test

s0_synthetic.model: h = a p(t) + b exp(j psi) p(t-delta), psi independent of delta (LAW mode); PHYSICAL mode psi=-2*pi*f_c*delta reported without slope criterion

p3_hardware_arms.E5_reporting: largest tested grid point meeting allowed_auc_loss
p3_hardware_arms.offset_application: frequency domain exp(-j*2*pi*f*Delta) on minus port; independent of tap grid
